assets.name: netcon-banner-gpt-v3.png
assets.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Create a finished panoramic NETCON application banner using the supplied logo and marquee as the exact brand references. Preserve the recognizable angular chrome NETCON lettering and network globe emblem. One unified horizontal composition: globe emblem left, large NETCON wordmark across the center, a quiet dark recessed instrument panel on the right for live app status text. The banner itself is premium detailed 16-bit cyberpunk pixel art: hard pixel clusters, metallic silver bevels, dark graphite rails, luminous cyan circuit lines, subtle violet shadows and tiny amber indicator lights. Deep almost-black navy background, industrial console casing and layered metal corners. It should feel like an expensive 1990s console cyberpunk menu, with readable luminous artwork and crisp pixels, not smooth vector art.
Very wide landscape at about 3:1. IMPORTANT safe area: keep the entire essential globe and wordmark within the middle 50 percent of image height (y=25% to 75%) so a short desktop header crop retains the complete brand. Use top and bottom thirds for decorative industrial rail extensions. Keep the rightmost 22 percent visually quiet for app status. Only text is exactly NETCON; no extra labels or simulated UI text. No second duplicated emblem, no character portraits, no desktop screenshot or outer app window. This is a real standalone banner texture filling the whole canvas.

assets.name: netcon-ui-concept-gpt-v3.png
assets.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a complete premium 16-bit pixel-art desktop application UI concept for NETCON using the attached official brand mark and marquee as branding references. Preserve the angular chrome NETCON wordmark and glowing network globe. Wide landscape screen, crisp pixel clusters and controlled dithering, black navy interiors, sculpted silver metal frames, cyan light channels, subtle violet accents and small amber indicators, consistent console-era cyberpunk industrial detailing.
This is a usable desktop tool, with a modest branded header at top, tabs labeled "BADGE STUDIO", "RFID INVENTORY", "LOCK SERVICE", "GAME LIBRARY". BADGE STUDIO is selected. Main screen is a balanced two-column workspace. Left column is "CARD DETAILS": neatly aligned editable fields for "Template", "Name", "Role", "Site", "Card ID", "Issued", "Expires"; a small portrait import area and buttons "SAVE RECORD", "EXPORT". Right column is "LIVE PREVIEW": a finished fictional Netcon company badge card with globe branding, a small original 16-bit cyberpunk technician portrait, sample name "ALEX RIVERS", title "TECHNICIAN", ID "NC-0042"; below are Front/Back tabs and "EXPORT BOTH SIDES". A slim footer says "LOCAL / READY". Accurate generous spacing, large dark work surfaces and readable concise typography; put intricate metal detail on borders, not behind text. Add a small chrome/cyan cursor visible near EXPORT to demonstrate matching cursor art. No real state ID, fake network statistics, terminal gibberish, external screenshot or photographed monitor. Render the full coherent screen with all edges inside the image.

assets.name: netcon-frames-gpt-v3.png
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 16-bit GUI FRAME ATLAS for the NETCON desktop app, based on the attached chrome/cyan/violet logo. Transparent PNG. Exact layout: 2 columns by 2 rows of FOUR SEPARATE EMPTY RECTANGULAR PANEL FRAMES, identical dimensions, one centered in each equal quadrant. No overlap, each frame has clear transparent space around it. All four are completely visible.
Each frame: premium hard-edged 16-bit cyberpunk industrial chrome casing, about 5 percent thick border, beveled silver corners, cyan light tracks, small violet inset accents and amber status pixels. Empty center must be a solid very dark navy #0b1726 so application controls can sit inside. Straight horizontal and vertical middle edges suited for 9-slice scaling; detailed corners; do not put logos, words, dividers, widgets, icons, buttons or decoration inside the empty centers.
Top-left: STANDARD cyan/silver frame.
Top-right: FOCUSED frame with stronger cyan lights and brighter silver corners.
Bottom-left: INACTIVE frame, dim slate metal and muted violet lines.
Bottom-right: DIALOG frame with violet corner accents, silver metal and cyan highlights.
All four have the same proportions, same corner geometry, and similar edge thickness. Entire canvas 3:2 landscape; every frame approximately 3:2. Only pixel-art frames and their dark interiors, real alpha transparency in gutters and outside frames. Do NOT draw a checkerboard, labels, color swatches, UI screenshot or outside scenery. Crisp pixel clusters and dithering, no blurred glow.

assets.name: netcon-cursors-gpt-v3.png
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: NETCON production CURSOR SPRITE ATLAS. Create exactly TWELVE individually separated 16-bit pixel-art mouse cursors in a strict regular 4-column by 3-row grid. Every equal cell has exactly one centered cursor; all shapes fully contained with generous empty alpha gutters. No words, no labels, no grid lines, no checkerboard, no background scene. The canvas background must be completely transparent.
Style: sharp readable cursor silhouettes, beveled chrome-silver bodies, bright cyan pixel edges, dark navy outlines, tiny violet shadow details, matching the attached Netcon logo's palette. Practical cursors readable at 32–48 pixels, simple strong shapes with excellent contrast, crisp pixels, no soft glow or detached sparkles.
Exact row-major order:
Row 1: up-left arrow pointer; pointing hand with index finger up; I-beam text insertion cursor; crosshair.
Row 2: four-direction move arrows; horizontal double-ended resize arrow; vertical double-ended resize arrow; diagonal northwest-southeast resize arrow.
Row 3: diagonal northeast-southwest resize arrow; segmented circular busy ring; prohibited circle with diagonal slash; up-left arrow pointer with small question mark.
Keep all twelve in their cells, one cursor per cell, consistent scale and border thickness. Transparent isolated sprite artwork, not a screenshot, icon poster or illustrative design presentation.

assets.name: netcon-buttons-gpt-v3.png
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production NETCON 16-bit BUTTON FRAME atlas, transparent background, four separate wide empty buttons stacked in ONE COLUMN and FOUR ROWS. Each equal row contains one centered rectangular 5:1 button with clear alpha spacing on all sides. Same size and silhouette in all rows. Chrome silver bevels, precise cyan light tracks, tiny violet shading, dark navy empty center matching #0b1726. Keep border thin, around 7 percent of button height; small angular corner cuts; middle edges straight for 9-slice use. Practical rich pixel art, deliberate clusters, pixel dithering, no blurry glow.
Row 1 normal silver/cyan.
Row 2 hover/focus brighter cyan border and lit corner nodes.
Row 3 pressed deeper inset navy and violet/cyan rim.
Row 4 disabled dim slate grey metal and subdued violet accents.
No words, no symbols, no logos, no numbers, no inner dividers; centers are empty for live UI text. Do not draw a checkerboard or scenery. Outside buttons and between rows must be real alpha transparency. Use the reference only for chrome/cyan/violet visual style.
